ingredients.name: boneless, skinless turkey thighs, cut into 2-inch chunks
dried ancho chiles, stemmed and seeded
dried guajillo chiles, stemmed and seeded
dried pasilla chile, stemmed and seeded
raw sesame seeds
ingredients.note: plus extra for garnish if desired

ingredients.name: Mexican chocolate (such as Abuelita or Ibarra), chopped

steps.title: Toast the dried chiles
steps.text: Heat a dry 12-inch HexClad skillet over medium heat. Press {ancho_chiles}, {guajillo_chiles}, and {pasilla_chile} flat against the pan in batches for 10 to 15 seconds per side until fragrant and pliable, taking care not to burn them or the sauce will turn bitter.

steps.title: Rehydrate the chiles
steps.text: Transfer the toasted chiles to a heatproof bowl and pour {chicken_broth} (warmed to a simmer) over them. Submerge with a small plate and soak for 20 minutes until completely softened.

steps.title: Toast the nuts, seeds, and tortilla
steps.text: In the same dry HexClad skillet over medium-low heat, toast {sesame_seeds}, {slivered_almonds}, and {corn_tortilla} for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring constantly until golden and nutty. Transfer to your Vitamix blender.

steps.title: Char the aromatics and tomatoes
steps.text: Add 1 tbsp of {avocado_oil} to the HexClad skillet over medium-high heat. Sear {yellow_onion} and {roma_tomatoes} cut-side down for 6 to 8 minutes until deeply charred and softened. Stir in {jarred_garlic} for the final 60 seconds until fragrant, then transfer everything to the Vitamix.

steps.title: Blend the mole base
steps.text: Add the soaked chiles, their soaking broth, {raisins}, {peanut_butter}, {ground_cumin}, {ground_cinnamon}, {mexican_oregano}, {ground_cloves}, and {kosher_salt_sauce} to the Vitamix. Blend on high for 2 minutes until completely velvety and smooth.

steps.title: Sear the turkey thighs
steps.text: Pat {turkey_thighs} dry and season evenly with {kosher_salt_turkey} and {black_pepper}. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp of {avocado_oil} in your Dutch oven or deep HexClad pan over medium-high heat and sear the turkey pieces for 2 to 3 minutes per side until lightly browned.

steps.title: Simmer the mole and braise the turkey
steps.text: Pour the blended mole sauce over the seared turkey in the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat, cover with a tight-fitting lid, and braise for 25 to 30 minutes until the turkey is tender and registers at least 175 degrees F internally.

steps.title: Melt the chocolate and finish
steps.text: Uncover the pan, stir in {mexican_chocolate}, and simmer gently for 5 minutes until melted and glossy. Check the consistency and splash in extra broth or water if needed so the sauce stays thick, velvety, and coats every piece generously.
